question: The sides of a triangle are 41 cm, 84 cm and 85 cm. What is the length of its altitude corresponding to the side with the length of 84 cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sides 41 cm and 85 cm act as the hypotenuses of two right-angled triangles sharing a common altitude.

Recall standard Pythagorean triplets: (9, 40, 41) and (40, 75, 85) [which is 5 × (8, 15, 17)].

Notice that both triplets uniquely share the common height of 40 cm.

The sum of their bases = 9 + 75 = 84 cm, which perfectly matches the third side of our triangle!

Thus, the altitude corresponding to the side of 84 cm is simply 40 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the triangle, a = 84 cm, b = 85 cm, c = 41 cm

**Formula Used:**

Semi-perimeter, s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

Area of triangle by Heron's formula = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Area of triangle = (1/2) × Base × Altitude
